title.zh: 美债收益率上升抑制科技股乐观情绪导致标普期货持平；伊朗紧张局势支撑油价
title.en: S&P Futures Flat as Higher Yields Counter Tech Optimism; Iran Tensions Support Oil

summary.en: US stock futures are mixed ahead of open, with Nasdaq futures leading gains while broader market faces headwinds from elevated 10Y Treasury yields. Iran tensions keep oil prices elevated despite recent pullbacks, and investors await key economic data including consumer confidence.
summary.zh: 美股期货早盘表现分化，纳斯达克期指领涨而大盘受制于高位美债收益率。伊朗紧张局势支撑油价尽管近期有所回落，投资者等待包括消费者信心在内的关键经济数据。

title.zh: 亚洲市场因贸易紧张担忧而下跌
title.en: Asian Markets Decline on Trade Tension Concerns

summary.en: Asian markets close mixed with Japan and Korea indexes slightly lower amid ongoing trade tension concerns. Pre-market futures indicate modest downside pressure on U.S. equities as investors digest geopolitical developments in the Middle East and assess their impact on oil prices, inflation expectations, and Fed policy timing. Key focus remains on whether supply chain disruptions will anchor inflation above the Fed's 2% target.
summary.zh: 亚洲市场收市分化，日本和韩国指数小幅下跌，贸易紧张局势持续引发担忧。美股盘前期货暗示适度下行压力，投资者正在消化中东地缘政治发展及其对油价、通胀预期和美联储政策时机的影响。重点关注供应链中断是否会迫使通胀锚定在美联储 2% 目标之上。

summary.en: Asian markets show mixed signals ahead of U.S. open, with focus on tech earnings and Fed commentary. Oil prices stable near key support levels despite geopolitical tension. DXY consolidation in narrow range as traders await CPI print. Treasury yields holding steady; 10Y yield near 4.1% amid inflation data expectations.
summary.zh: 美股开盘前，亚洲股市表现分化，市场聚焦科技股财报与美联储官员言论。油价在关键支撑位附近企稳，尽管地缘政治紧张持续。美元指数窄幅震荡等待 CPI 数据公布；美债收益率稳定在 4.1% 左右。

title.zh: 特朗普与习近平会谈前，中东不确定性导致华尔街期货下跌
title.en: Wall St futures fall on Middle East uncertainties ahead of Trump-Xi talks

summary.en: Markets declined amid Middle East uncertainties ahead of Trump-Xi talks, with US Treasury yields surging and DXY strengthening on better-than-expected PMI data. Geopolitical risks dominate sentiment as investors worry about trade tensions and broader economic overheating fears.
summary.zh: 受中东不确定性影响，特朗普与习近平会谈在即，美股下跌，美债收益率飙升，美元指数在 PMI 数据好于预期的情况下走强。地缘政治风险主导市场情绪，投资者担忧贸易紧张局势和更广泛的经济过热担忧。

title.zh: 美国股票期货持平，地缘政治谈话抵消 AI 上涨
title.en: U.S. Stock Futures Flat as Geopolitical Talks Offset AI Rally

summary.en: U.S. index futures flat to slightly down as geopolitical de-escalation hopes (Iran talks, Mideast summit) offset AI sector optimism. Oil retreats below $95 with Gulf supply increase and pipeline repair reducing crisis premium. Pre-market focus on Trump-Xi summit preparation alongside Fed rate decision anticipation for Thursday.
summary.zh: 美国指数期货基本持平至轻微下跌，地缘政治缓和希望（伊朗谈话、中东峰会）抵消 AI 板块乐观情绪。油价回落至 95 美元以下，海湾供应增加和管道维修减少了危机溢价。盘前焦点为特朗普与习近平峰会准备，以及周四美联储利率决策预期。

title.zh: 美债收益率企稳，市场等待美联储评论
title.en: Treasury Yields Stabilize as Market Waits for Fed Commentary

summary.en: Pre-market focus remains on geopolitical developments affecting energy markets, with Treasury yields tracking inflation expectations amid limited major corporate earnings. Asian markets showed mixed activity following Friday's close, while futures suggest a neutral to slightly positive opening sentiment.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点集中在影响能源市场的地缘政治动态，美债收益率追踪通胀预期。亚洲市场在周五收盘后表现分化，而期货预示中性至略微偏多的开盘情绪。

title.zh: 成长股与价值股之间的板块轮动持续
title.en: Sector Rotation Continues Between Growth and Value Stocks

summary.en: US pre-market shows mixed sentiment with sector rotation continuing between growth and value stocks. Treasury yields remain elevated while oil prices stabilize, creating uncertainty for rate-sensitive sectors. No major geopolitical developments overnight; focus remains on Fed policy positioning and earnings expectations.
summary.zh: 美盘前呈现混合情绪，成长股和价值股之间的轮动仍在持续。美债收益率保持高位而油价稳定，造成利率敏感型板块的不确定性。隔夜无重大地缘政治发展；焦点仍集中在美联储政策定位和盈利预期上。

title.zh: 明天 FOMC 决策：油价冲击考验美联储降通胀承诺
title.en: FOMC Decision Tomorrow: Oil Price Shock Tests Fed Disinflation Commitment

summary.en: After the September 15–16 FOMC meeting, investors continued to assess how Middle East oil supply disruptions and elevated energy prices could affect inflation, Treasury yields, and the Fed’s policy outlook.
summary.zh: 9 月 15 至 16 日的美联储议息会议结束后，投资者继续评估中东石油供应中断和能源价格高企对通胀、美债收益率及美联储政策前景的影响。

title.zh: 亚洲股票指数下跌，美国投资者在地缘政治油价冲击中为 FOMC 决策做准备
title.en: Asian Equity Indices Decline as US Investors Brace for FOMC Decision Amid Geopolitical Oil Shock

summary.en: Pre-market attention on Fed Chair Warsh's ongoing rate policy communication amid geopolitical oil supply disruption from Middle East. Asian markets showed mixed signals overnight with Japan/Korea declining while energy-related sectors outperformed. Investors await tomorrow's FOMC decision for clarity on inflation trajectory and timing of the rate hike.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点关注美联储主席 Warsh 持续的利率政策沟通，同时中东地缘政治油价供应中断引发关注。亚洲市场隔夜表现分化，日/韩指数下跌而能源相关板块超额表现。投资者等待明天的 FOMC 决策以获取通胀轨迹和加息时机的明朗化。

title.zh: 美联储主席 Warsh 的讲话可能超越预期的利率上调，中东紧张局势升级
title.en: Fed Chair Warsh's Speech May Trump Anticipated Rate Hike as Mideast Tensions Escalate

summary.en: Pre-market attention focuses on the Fed rate decision with Warsh's speech expected to provide key guidance. Oil prices remain elevated amid Middle East supply concerns, while geopolitical tensions continue to dominate market narratives over earnings and tech sector developments.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点集中在美联储利率决策，Warsh 的讲话预计将提供关键指引。油价在中东供应担忧中保持高位，地缘政治紧张局势继续主导市场叙事，超过财报和科技板块发展。

title.zh: 美股期指在业绩季前因亚洲市场稳健而上涨
title.en: Wall Street futures gain on resilient Asian markets ahead of earnings surge

summary.en: Pre-market focus centers on earnings expectations ahead of earnings season and broader macro positioning as markets digest Fed commentary. Asian market close showed modest gains while futures track cautiously upward.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点集中在财报季预期及宏观配置，市场消化美联储言论。亚洲股市小幅收涨，期货谨慎上行。

title.zh: NVIDIA 和 AMD 在更广泛的科技财报前保持 AI 芯片动量
title.en: NVIDIA and AMD maintain AI chip momentum ahead of broader tech earnings

summary.en: Markets close after Friday with mixed signals as investors digest weekend geopolitical developments and wait for September jobs data on Tuesday. AI chip sector shows resilience despite broader tech slowdown concerns, while energy prices remain elevated amid OPEC+ supply constraints.
summary.zh: 周五收盘后市场呈现混合信号，投资者正在消化周末的地缘政治动态并等待周二的九月就业数据。AI 芯片板块在更广泛的科技放缓担忧中显示出韧性，而能源价格在 OPEC+供应约束下保持高位。

title.zh: 油价因 OPEC+ 减产预期上涨，提振能源股
title.en: Oil Prices Rise on OPEC+ Production Cut Hopes Boosting Energy Stocks

summary.en: Friday morning markets focus on weekly economic data releases and earnings season mid-point, with investors watching for inflation implications ahead of potential Fed policy guidance. Energy sector gains from OPEC+ discussions while tech faces volatility on AI regulatory concerns.
summary.zh: 周五盘前市场关注每周经济数据发布及财报季中段，投资者观望通胀对美联储政策指引的影响。受 OPEC+ 讨论影响，能源股上涨，科技股受 AI 监管担忧而波动。

title.zh: 美联储官员表示对降息保持谨慎态度，因通胀数据持续
title.en: Fed Officials Signal Cautious Approach to Rate Cuts as Inflation Data Lingers

summary.en: US markets open with attention on Fed rate expectations and tech earnings season progress. Pre-market focus remains on AI sector leadership amid mixed macro data, while geopolitical developments in energy markets keep oil prices elevated.
summary.zh: 美国市场开盘关注美联储利率预期和科技股财报季进展。盘前焦点集中在人工智能板块领导地位，尽管宏观数据喜忧参半，而能源市场的地缘政治动态维持油价高位。

title.zh: 油价接近 100 美元/桶，中东冲突因胡塞武装袭击沙特设施而升级
title.en: Oil Nears $100/barrel as Middle East Conflict Intensifies with Houthi Attacks on Saudi Facilities

summary.en: U.S. stocks fell sharply amid escalating Middle East tensions, with oil prices surging toward $100/barrel following attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and Iranian tanker by Houthi rebels. The Dow Jones slid ~550 points while inflation concerns pushed Treasury yields higher.
summary.zh: 美国股市大幅下跌，中东紧张局势升级。油价受也门胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施及伊朗油轮事件影响飙升至 100 美元/桶附近。道琼斯指数下跌约 550 点，通胀担忧推动美债收益率上升。

title.zh: Jackson Hole 央行峰会前美联储讲话维持偏鹰基调
title.en: Jackson Hole Fed speakers maintain rate-hawkish tone ahead of central bank summit

summary.en: Fed speakers at Jackson Hole remain hawkish, with Powell's recent comments keeping rate-cut expectations in check through Q3. Treasury yields steadied after last week's July PCE print, while oil continues to face pressure from Middle East de-escalation hopes despite supply constraints. Tech leads broadly, but the rally is event-driven and sensitive to Fed commentary rather than a full macro breakout.
summary.zh: Jackson Hole 美联储讲话保持偏鹰，鲍威尔的近期表态使降息预期在 Q3 内受限。美债收益率在上周 7 月 PCE 数据后企稳，而油价仍受中东降温预期压制。科技股领涨，但行情是事件驱动的，对美联储讲话高度敏感，而非全面的宏观突破。

title.zh: 周五收盘在即：科技股盈利季推进与利率敏感性
title.en: Friday Close Looming: Tech Earnings Season Progression & Rate Sensitivity

summary.en: Friday pre-market context: External web sources unavailable due to authentication barriers. Key focus remains on Friday's close positioning, weekend risk events, and Monday expectations. Geopolitical developments (Middle East tensions) continue monitoring oil and safe-haven flows.
summary.zh: 周五盘前背景：因认证障碍外部网络源不可用。重点关注周五收市布局、周末风险事件及周一预期。中东局势持续监控石油与避险流向。

title.zh: 主要云服务商扩大 GPU 基础设施，推动 AI 芯片需求激增
title.en: AI Chip Demand Surges as Major Cloud Providers Expand GPU Infrastructure

summary.en: Pre-market focus remains on earnings season continuation with key semiconductor and AI chip designers reporting, while geopolitical developments in the Middle East continue to influence oil prices and inflation expectations. Market breadth appears cautious ahead of Thursday's open.
summary.zh: 财报季尚未结束，盘前投资者关注半导体与 AI 芯片设计公司的业绩。中东局势仍影响油价和通胀预期。周四开盘前，个股表现和市场情绪仍偏谨慎。
